adr.md: Create an Architecture Decision Record in memory-bank ADR registry (adr.md)
agree.md: Manage the running list of agreements — the canonical registry of confirmed decisions
analyze-task.md: Auto-classify the goal + diff scope into one route and write it into the mb-flow fence
api-contract.md: Manage API contracts — OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, breaking-change detection
brief.md: Turn a raw request plus attached documents into a validated one-page brief under briefs/<topic>/
catchup.md: Reload the current context after a reset or compaction
commit.md: Review staged changes and create a commit
config.md: Manage execution pipeline.yaml — init / show / validate / path
contract.md: Contract-First — define the interface, write contract tests, then implement
db-migration.md: Create and manage DB migrations across 8+ tools
discuss.md: 5-phase requirements-elicitation interview that produces an EARS-validated context/<topic>.md
doc.md: Generate or update documentation for a module
done.md: End session — actualize core MB files, create a note, append to progress
drive.md: Drive a goal to completion over the deterministic firewall — the autonomous goal-driven loop
flow.md: Select a route directly (skip classification) — the explicit override escape-hatch
goal.md: Scaffold and validate the durable goal.md + project.md artifacts
groom.md: Critical grooming session for any task or idea — challenge necessity and approach, cover white spots, record decisions into the existing bank structures. No spec required.
mb.md: Memory Bank — long-term project memory management
observability.md: Add structured logging, metrics, and tracing to a module
plan.md: Create a detailed work plan with DoD and save it in memory-bank
pr.md: Create a PR from the current branch
profile.md: Manage rule profiles and stack presets — personalize the configurable rules layer without weakening the immutable safety baseline
refactor.md: Refactor the specified module while preserving behavior
review.md: Full review of uncommitted code — principles, architecture, tests, security
roadmap-sync.md: Regenerate roadmap.md autosync block from plans/*.md frontmatter
rules.md: Manage the Key rules block — choose catalog rules and add your own rules for CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md
security-review.md: Scan code for security vulnerabilities (OWASP, secrets, dependencies)
start.md: Load current project context from memory-bank
test.md: Run tests, analyze failures, and propose fixes
traceability-gen.md: Regenerate traceability.md from specs + plans + tests
work.md: Execute Memory Bank workflow modes from pipeline.yaml — existing plan/spec execution by default, optional full-cycle requirements→plan→implementation→review flows.
